cards.audioText: Did you have a good sleep last night?
cards.referenceText: Yes, I did, I had a good sleep last night./No, I didn’t, I was a little nervous and I had a poor sleep last night.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我昨天休息得很好。/不，我有点紧张，昨天没休息好。

cards.audioText: Do you think it's important for pilots to keep healthy?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得对飞行员来说保持身体健康是否重要？
cards.referenceText: Yes, of course, pilots must keep healthy to ensure the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当然重要，为了确保飞行安全，飞行员必须保持身体健康。

cards.audioText: Have you tried to keep fit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在尽力保持身体健康吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I pay much attention to my health. Health is very important to pilots, and it is closely related to the ﬂight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我很重视我的健康状况。对于飞行员来说，健康状况非常重要，飞行员的健康与飞行安全有着紧密的联系。

cards.audioText: Do you try to keep fit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在尽力保持身体健康吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I pay much attention to my health. Health is very important to pilots, and it is closely related to the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我很重视我的健康状况。对于飞行员来说，健康状况非常重要，健康与飞行安全有着紧密的联系。

cards.audioText: When do you usually exercise? / What do you usually do to keep fit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你通常什么时候锻炼？/你通常如何锻炼来保持身体健康？
cards.referenceText: I often do different exercises in my spare time. My favorite sport is basketball. Sometimes I ride a bike, go swimming or climb mountains with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空闲时我会做各种运动。我最喜欢打篮球，有时也会骑自行车、游泳或是和家人一起爬山。

cards.audioText: How do you usually exercise? / How do you usually do to keep fit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你通常怎样进行锻炼?/你通常如何锻炼来保持身体健康？
cards.referenceText: I often do different exercises in my spare time. My favorite is basketball. Sometimes I ride a bike, go swimming or climb mountains with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空闲时我会做各种运动。我最喜欢打篮球，有时也会骑自行车、游泳或是和家人一起爬山。

cards.audioText: What is the best method to keep fit in your opinion?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为保持健康最好的方法是什么？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, the best way to keep fit is living a regular life, keeping a good mood, doing regular exercises and having a proper diet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为保持健康最好的方法是生活规律、保持好心情、经常锻炼、合理饮食。

cards.audioText: How do you balance rest and work?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何平衡休息和工作？
cards.referenceText: During my work/duty time, I should work hard, and during my rest/spare time, I will have enough rest and I often do some exercise.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我工作/值勤期间，我会努力工作；休息/空闲时间，我会充分地休息，有时也会做些运动。

cards.audioText: Do you think pilots have enough rest between flights, why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员在飞行任务之间有足够的休息时间吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Generally speaking, we should have 14 hours of rest between flights. I think it's enough.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一般来说，我们在飞行任务之间要有14个小时的休息。我认为是足够了。
